intent: 在专业编辑器中，让用户在执行修改前能看见当前写入对象、写入层级以及可能影响的对象数量，而不把这层解释 UI 变成新的状态所有者。
use_when: 同一参数可能写入共享 Style 或单 Event override
工具可绑定 Focus/Selection/Pinned target 等不同对象
一次操作可能影响多个对象
do_not_use_when: 操作目标天然唯一且无共享/批量语义
提示本身会复制并拥有可编辑领域状态

interaction_contract.derived_only: scope explanation is computed from canonical document plus tool binding
interaction_contract.unresolved: retain former pinned identity and expose affected count 0 instead of silently falling back
interaction_contract.hosts: fixed and floating/Canvas hosts consume the same resolver
interaction_contract.mutation: banner never becomes a mutation target or second owner

visual_contract.prominence: visible near mutating controls without competing with primary content
visual_contract.uncertainty: unresolved state is explicit rather than hidden
visual_contract.count: affected-count changes are visible before destructive/shared edits

constraints: The explanation MUST be derived from canonical state and Binding.
Shared Style and Event Override must not be visually collapsed into one write target.
Unresolved pinned targets must not silently fall back to global Focus.
Action-dependent operations need action-specific scope metadata rather than a generic banner.
